speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: The sputum culture came back normal, which is interesting given the green phlegm. Since the X-ray shows hyperinflation and your lung function tests confirm COPD, have you noticed if your symptoms worsen specifically during certain seasons or when exposed to cold air?
